traits.desc: The cueyatl can breathe air and water.

traits.desc: The cueyatl has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in jungle terrain.

traits.desc: The cueyatl has advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to escape a grapple.
